runtime.max_total_tokens_selection_rule: single predeclared candidate; abort rather than retune if capacity gate fails
runtime.cache_topology_acceptance: startup log must prove impl=SWARadixCache hybrid_swa=True
runtime.cache_topology_rationale: The pinned Gemma4 runtime's supported KV layout is the default hybrid SWA topology. An ordinary RadixCache launch reached readiness but crashed on the first Gemma4 forward in the Triton KV-buffer write path; all required arms therefore share the default SWARadixCache with its effective LRU retention.

physical_eviction_metric_registration.launch_gate: require the metrics endpoint plus kv_evictable_tokens and swa_evictable_tokens; the physical-eviction counter and histogram do not register until the first eviction
physical_eviction_metric_registration.non_measured_primer: on every fresh server launch, replay frozen calibration one-off prompts only until a real physical eviction registers both metric families; retain a receipt, flush cache, and reset native action counters before any measured or resumed cell
physical_eviction_metric_registration.actual_sample_rule: every measured before and after snapshot must contain both registered definitions and actually emitted evicted-token and eviction-count samples; runner-synthesized zero samples do not qualify
physical_eviction_metric_registration.delta_rule: all cell deltas subtract actually emitted monotonic samples captured after the excluded primer; calibration, smoke, and evaluation begin from a flushed cache with reset native action counters

optional_frequency_aware_baseline.request: LFU or another frequency-aware retention baseline, if feasible
optional_frequency_aware_baseline.reason: A genuine LFU arm requires ordinary RadixCache because the pinned SWARadixCache uses LRU internally. Ordinary RadixCache with the frozen Gemma4 configuration crashes on the first forward before a measured request completes.

arm_order_design.method: four cyclic Latin rows followed by the first row
arm_order_design.balance_statement: Each seed contains every arm exactly once. Across five seeds every arm appears in every position, with one position repeated; exact integer equality is impossible because five is not divisible by four.

workload.pressure_requirement: one-off prompt tokens admitted by native admit-all exceed four times max_total_tokens
workload.hot_set_requirement: combined hot prefixes consume no more than half max_total_tokens
workload.useful_hot_hit_rule: cached_tokens must be at least the pinned tokenizer token count of the full family shared_prefix_text; page_size is frozen to 1

freeze_rule: write calibration_receipt.json and evaluation_freeze.json before the first smoke or evaluation request; evaluation_freeze hash is immutable thereafter
